event.title: Linux Day Pesaro 2026 in Pesaro, Italia

body.p: Have you ever heard of Linux but don’t know what it is? Would you like to find out more about Free Software? Come along to Linux Day 2026 in Pesaro – there’ll be six talks:
📍 Walter Vannini, long-standing podcaster of DataKnightmare and Global DPO
📍 Lorenzo Lugli, remember the Italian Crackdown and the Autistici/Inventati case
📍 Luca Bonissi, Free Software Foundation Europe
📍 Federico Simoncelli, Red Hat deputy chair
📍 Riccardo Dafne, Giovanni Gasparre, Giovanni Mazza, RDE
📍 Giovanni Montini, with a workshop on Internet Time, NTP
We wait for you at the “Vittorio Bobbato” Library and Archive, at the Ipercoop Miralfiore in Pesaro.
